final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS player_count FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON h.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.player_count) AS avg_player_count, AVG(s.player_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND s.player_count > o.avg_count
